title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Prepaid Hour Block Terms by Program
content:
**Term 1 — What a block is.** Technician hours are credited to a rate program held under the Demand Service Rate Programs when a
block is bought under it. The hours credited figure states the hours a block carries under that program;
where it stands at 0 the program sells no blocks.

**Term 2 — Price and size.** The block rate is the rate at which block hours are sold, in US dollars per
hour, and the minimum purchase is the smallest block that may be bought, in hours.

**Term 3 — Expiry and rollover.** The expiry period is the number of calendar months after purchase at
which unused block hours expire. The rollover column states whether unused hours roll into the next
program year at renewal.

**Term 4 — Overage and refund.** The overage rate is the rate billed for labor hours beyond the
remaining block, in US dollars per hour. The refund portion is the portion of unused block hours
refunded at cancellation, in percent.

| Program | Hours credited by a block | Block rate (USD per hour) | Minimum purchase (hours) | Expiry (calendar months) | Rollover at renewal | Overage rate (USD per hour) | Refund portion at cancellation (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Time & Material Account | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | 165 | 0 |
| Priority Response Program | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | No | 152 | 0 |
| Block Hour Service Program | 40 | 132 | 40 | 12 | Yes | 144 | 50 |
| Emergency Response Program | 80 | 126 | 40 | 12 | Yes | 138 | 50 |
| Critical Facility Response Program | 120 | 120 | 60 | 18 | Yes | 132 | 75 |
| Dedicated Technician Program | 200 | 114 | 100 | 24 | Yes | 126 | 100 |

**Term 5 — Programs that sell no blocks.** The Time & Material Account and the Priority Response Program
carry 0 in the hours credited, block rate, minimum purchase and expiry columns and No in the rollover
column: no block may be bought under them. Their overage rates of 165 and 152 US dollars per hour stand
as published rates of those programs notwithstanding.
